description: This file contains the final class ContactMechWorker which provides utility and worker methods for handling contact mechanisms such as postal addresses, telecom numbers, and FTP addresses within the OFBiz framework, including retrieval, creation, updating, and validation functions.

classes.name: ContactMechWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing contact mechanisms including addresses, numbers, and FTP addresses in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: insertRelatedContactElement
methods.description: Adds a related contact element (PostalAddress, TelecomNumber, or FtpAddress) to the elementMap based on contactMechTypeId.

methods.name: getPartyContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party, optionally filtered by type and date, returning a list of value maps with associated data.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a facility, optionally filtered by type and date.

methods.name: getOrderContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms associated with an order.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms associated with a work effort.

methods.name: getEntityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Generic method to retrieve contact mechanisms for an entity like order or work effort based on its view.

methods.name: getContactMechAndRelated
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism details and related entities for a given request and partyId.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechAndRelated
methods.description: Retrieves facility contact mechanism details and related entities, populating a target map.

methods.name: getPartyPostalAddresses
methods.description: Returns a list of postal addresses associated with a party, excluding the current contact mech if specified.

methods.name: getCurrentPostalAddress
methods.description: Returns details of the current postal address contact mech for a party.

methods.name: isUspsAddress
methods.description: Determines if a postal address matches USPS address patterns based on configuration.

methods.name: isCompanyAddress
methods.description: Checks if a postal address belongs to a specific company party ID by comparing address details.

methods.name: getContactMechAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value for a contactMechId.

methods.name: getPostalAddressPostalCodeGeoId
methods.description: Determines the geoId for postal code, trying shortcuts and associations.

methods.name: urlEncodePostalAddress
methods.description: Constructs a URL-encoded string of a postal address for sharing or hyperlinking.
